about: The mutant ledger of internal/selfhostcheck and the self-hosting pilot it tests (testdata/selfhost): edits of the Go adapter and of the Ergo tree decoder that TestSelfhostBridgeAgrees, or the adapter's TestFamiliesCoverSyntax, must kill. scripts/mutants judges only check and lower today, and the pilot is a nested Go module; until it has a suite, a unit that changes these files applies each edit by hand and runs the killer (wf10 SH0).

mutants.name: claim-law-permits-bare-self-call
mutants.rule: A constraint-only law has no ambient value for a bare operation call.

mutants.name: lower-agree-guess-field-export
mutants.rule: An unrenamed field with an X prefix remains different from the field named without that prefix.

mutants.name: lower-agree-guess-qualified-type
mutants.rule: A host-qualified generic head remains different even when its suffix and type arguments match.

mutants.name: lower-agree-guess-split-export
mutants.rule: An X-prefixed method remains a genuine difference unless this build's split exported it.

mutants.name: lower-agree-guess-slice-element-export
mutants.rule: An X-prefixed slice element type remains a genuine difference unless this build's split exported it.

mutants.name: pool-case-silently-dropped
mutants.from:
for _, d := range unusedDraws(pool) {
		if single(d.name, "p.ergo", d.src, d.check) {
mutants.to:
for _, d := range unusedDraws(pool)[1:] {
		if single(d.name, "p.ergo", d.src, d.check) {
mutants.rule: The agreement ratchet refuses to lose an existing unused-draw case by name, even when it has no disagreement site.

mutants.name: aw-selfhost-unread
mutants.rule: The self-hosted checker reports S108 for a // ergo:aswritten line above no pure identity of one parameter, as the Go checker does (aswritten-not-identity.ergo).

mutants.name: sh-comment-crosses-token
mutants.rule: A synthesized token found next in the source prints at its source position, so a comment before it stays before it.

mutants.name: sh-synth-merges-operator
mutants.rule: Two bytes that would lex as one token (- -) are written with a blank between them.

mutants.name: sh-precedence-loses-parens
mutants.rule: The precedence table is syntax.Token.Precedence: % binds at level 5, which decides the blanks around it (gofmt's cutoff).

mutants.name: sh-align-counts-bytes
mutants.rule: A column's width counts runes, not bytes.

mutants.name: sh-align-taper-overpads
mutants.rule: The section bound: once a cell is wider than alignSmall, every cell of the section stays within alignRatio of the widest.

mutants.name: sh-limit-allows-one-extra-byte
mutants.rule: A positive limit one byte below the size is refused.

mutants.name: sh-newline-duplicates-empty-line
mutants.rule: A line break asked as never blank (after an opener) never keeps the source's blank line.

mutants.name: sh-empty-column-adds-width
mutants.rule: A column block of empty cells takes no width.

mutants.name: sh-finish-builds-before-limit
mutants.rule: A refusal is decided from the computed size before any text is built (the refusal reports the bytes built: none).

mutants.name: sh-trailing-comment-unaligned
mutants.rule: A comment that ends a line is a cell of its own, aligned with the trailing comments of its neighbours.

mutants.name: sh-clause-comment-joins-next
mutants.rule: A comment after a clause's last statement belongs to the next clause when a blank line separates it from the statement.

mutants.name: sh-one-line-body-holds-two
mutants.rule: A braced body stays on one line with at most one element: an explicit ; becomes a line break.

mutants.name: sh-forces-break-misses-catch
mutants.rule: A catch prints its clauses on lines of their own, so a body that holds one is never on one line.

mutants.name: sh-blank-kept-before-comma
mutants.rule: After a block comment on the same line, no blank is written before a comma (go/printer).

mutants.name: sh-number-selector-glues
mutants.rule: A selector on a number literal keeps a blank before the dot, or `0.A` would scan as the number `0.`.

mutants.name: sh-slice-blanks-one-index
mutants.rule: A slice expression has blanks around its colons only when more than one index is present and one is binary.

mutants.name: sh-union-ignores-variant-span
mutants.rule: A union prints one variant per line when a variant spans several source lines.

mutants.name: sh-if-end-ignores-else
mutants.from: return if els != uint32(0) { endOf(t, k, els-uint32(1)) } else { endOf(t, k, fixed(t, x, 4, 1)) }
mutants.to: return if els != uint32(0) { endOf(t, k, fixed(t, x, 4, 1)) } else { endOf(t, k, fixed(t, x, 4, 1)) }
mutants.rule: An if ends where its else ends (syntax.IfStmt.End): an if on one line keeps its blocks on that line.

mutants.name: sh-separator-loses-tail
mutants.rule: After a separator the line's last byte is the last byte of its last non-empty cell, so a blank keeps two tokens apart across a column (the tail that replaces a read of the buffer).

mutants.name: sh-separator-keeps-blank
mutants.rule: A cell ended by a separator drops its trailing blanks before it is padded.

mutants.name: sh-steps-reads-emit-inverted
mutants.rule: Steps reads the command list the model writes.

mutants.name: b18-format-law-rewrite-as-body
mutants.from:
if x.Rewrite {
		// The rewrite form (types.md, Laws 14): its Body is synthetic
mutants.to:
if false {
		// The rewrite form (types.md, Laws 14): its Body is synthetic
mutants.rule: A rewrite law prints as `{ lhs } == { rhs }`, as the Go formatter's memberLaw does, not its synthetic Body.

mutants.name: b18-format-law-rewrite-drops-guard
mutants.rule: A rewrite law's `when R() == C` guard is printed (types.md Laws 14's SepAfterValue fence).

mutants.name: hostsyntax-format-limit-dropped
mutants.rule: The facade passes the limit: an output above a positive limit is refused, as format.FileBounded refuses it.

mutants.name: hostsyntax-format-partial-text
mutants.rule: A failure returns no text, as format.FileBounded's does.

mutants.name: sh-implements-dropped
mutants.rule: A type's implements clause is printed (types.md, Interface assignability 1).

mutants.name: sh-own-dropped
mutants.rule: A parameter's mode word own is printed.

mutants.name: sh-derive-reads-spec
mutants.rule: A derived type prints as written, `derive Bundle(…)`: it has no spec to read.

mutants.name: fmt-seed-oracle-is-self
mutants.to:
func seedFormat(bin, src string) (string, error) {
	return treeOutcome(hostsyntax.Source(src)), nil
mutants.rule: The oracle is the seed binary, not the tree's formatter: the planted source the seed refuses tells them apart.

mutants.name: hostsyntax-syntax-failure-swallowed
mutants.from:
if e := syntaxError(strings.TrimSuffix(s, "\n")); e != nil {
			return "", e
mutants.to:
if e := syntaxError(strings.TrimSuffix(s, "\n")); e != nil {
			return "", nil
mutants.rule: A source that does not parse is a located *syntax.Error, never an empty text.

mutants.name: sh-token-skips-merge
mutants.rule: A token the printer writes with no search for a line break still gets a blank before it when it would lex as one token with the last byte.

mutants.name: sh-line-probe-off-by-one
mutants.from:
if i+1 == n || syntax.LineStart(p.Lines, i+1) > at {
			line = i + 1
mutants.to:
if i+1 == n || syntax.LineStart(p.Lines, i+1) > at {
			line = i + 2
mutants.rule: The forward probe of ln names the line that holds the offset: the one whose start is at or before it and whose next line starts after it.

mutants.name: sh-raw-string-not-split
mutants.rule: A raw string the printer writes still goes through write, so its line breaks end layout lines that are never re-indented or aligned.

mutants.name: sh-walk-memo-dropped
mutants.rule: walkBinary is memoised by row: go/printer's cutoff asks it for every operator of a chain, which without the memo is quadratic in the chain's length (no output changes; SH1 gap 12).

mutants.name: sh-format-own-dropped
mutants.rule: A parameter's mode word own is printed (grammar Declarations 13); dropped, the formatted text loses it.

mutants.name: lower-union-injects-tag-zero
mutants.rule: A bare empty variant is injected by its declaration tag, not tag zero (PortUnionMakeMode).

mutants.name: lower-union-payload-field-key-lost
mutants.rule: Injection preserves the checked payload literal's Go field key (PortUnionMakeReading).

mutants.name: lower-match-case-tag-is-case-index
mutants.rule: Switch cases are in source order but compare the variant's declaration tag, not the case index (PortUnionModeRank).

mutants.name: lower-match-payload-reads-wrong-tag
mutants.rule: Narrowing reads the active variant's shared-slot reconstruction (PortUnionRead).

mutants.name: ir-invalid-utf8-kept
mutants.rule: Each byte of an invalid UTF-8 sequence is written as U+FFFD, as Go 1.27's encoding/json writes it.

mutants.name: ir-u2029-not-escaped
mutants.rule: U+2028 and U+2029 are both written as escapes.

mutants.name: ir-omit-keeps-empty-list
mutants.rule: omitempty drops an empty list that is not nil.

mutants.name: ir-int-high-half-dropped
mutants.rule: The file's version is the 64 bits of its two words, so a negative or large one is written as Go writes it.

mutants.name: ir-null-element-read-as-node
mutants.rule: A list element of id 0 is a nil node, written null.

mutants.name: ir-type-not-checked
mutants.rule: A row whose kind is of another struct type than its field names is Malformed, never written.

mutants.name: ir-zero-pos-not-written
mutants.rule: A position that is not set is Go's zero [3]int.

mutants.name: ir-slot-extra-off-by-one
mutants.rule: A kind of more than two slots holds its second slot at the extra offset in b.

mutants.name: ir-omitempty-ignored
mutants.rule: A row field whose tag says omitempty is dropped when it holds Go's zero value.

mutants.name: ir-fileof-keeps-nil
mutants.rule: A file the builder names makes the list of files non-nil.

mutants.name: ir-begin-keeps-nil
mutants.rule: A function the builder begins makes the list of functions non-nil.

mutants.name: ir-row-extra-from-first
mutants.rule: A kind of more than two slots keeps its first slot in a and the others in the extra pool.

mutants.name: lower-union-native-type-uses-wrong-declaration
mutants.rule: The generic spelling keeps the checked type's actual declaration (PortUnionOptionValues).

mutants.name: lower-union-native-type-args-reversed
mutants.from:
for j, arg in args {
		let gt = basicGo(st, arg)
mutants.to:
for j, _ in args {
		let gt = basicGo(st, args[len(args)-1-j])
mutants.rule: Native generic type spelling retains declaration order, even for unequal arguments (PortUnionDecisionValues).

mutants.name: lower-param-local-zero
mutants.rule: A pure function's parameter is the local of its place in the parameter list.

mutants.name: lower-bin-pos-start
mutants.rule: A binary expression's IR position is its operator's.

mutants.name: lower-string-unquoted
mutants.rule: A string constant's value is its literal unquoted as the checker reads it.

mutants.name: lower-method-name
mutants.rule: A function whose first parameter is a plain record of its package is the Go method T.name.

mutants.name: lower-borrow-store-plain-assignment
mutants.rule: Inc's compound store updates the existing field in the borrowed place; it does not overwrite with the right operand.

mutants.name: lower-borrow-receiver-passes-value
mutants.from: let recv = try ir.Row(b, ir.KindCode(ir.TExpr, "addr"), pos(st, call.recvAt), []uint32{place})
mutants.rule: BorrowedIncrement passes the address of the selected field as the receiver, not the field value.

mutants.name: lower-lit-keys-dropped
mutants.rule: A record literal's IR keys are its fields' Go names, in its elements' order.

mutants.name: sh-format-union-ends-decl
mutants.origin: wf10/selfhost/FMT-IMPLEMENTS (SELFHOST-MERGE x batch 23: on compiler/format; killer to judge at the batch)
mutants.rule: A union declaration still prints its where and implements clauses.
mutants.gap: survived at its named Go killer (scripts/mutants -run, 2026-11-19, SELFHOST-MERGE x batch 23): the killer runs the linked Go of compiler/, which the runner does not regenerate from the mutated .ergo; it needs an Ergo-test killer (ergotests) or a regenerate step (follow-up, every compiler/ row)

mutants.name: sh-format-include-dropped
mutants.origin: wf10/selfhost/FMT-MODES (SELFHOST-MERGE x batch 23: on compiler/format; killer to judge at the batch)
mutants.rule: An operation type's includes (..I) are printed among its members in source order.
mutants.gap: survived at its named Go killer (scripts/mutants -run, 2026-11-19, SELFHOST-MERGE x batch 23): the killer runs the linked Go of compiler/, which the runner does not regenerate from the mutated .ergo; it needs an Ergo-test killer (ergotests) or a regenerate step (follow-up, every compiler/ row)

mutants.name: lower-alias-dropped
mutants.from: if st.alias == "" { base } else { st.alias + "__" + base }
mutants.rule: A declaration of a package other than the build's root is spelled alias__name (NAME-LOCAL rule 2).

mutants.name: lower-let-local-index
mutants.from: let l = try letOf(*st, syntax.Item(p.Tree, list, i), n+i)
mutants.to: let l = try letOf(*st, syntax.Item(p.Tree, list, i), i)
mutants.rule: A let's local follows the function's parameters' slots.

mutants.name: lower-call-name-bare
mutants.from: aCall{name: g, method: false, args: args}
mutants.to: aCall{name: name, method: false, args: args}
mutants.rule: A call names its callee by the callee's Go name: alias__name outside the build's root (NAME-LOCAL).

mutants.name: lower-mcall-as-call
mutants.rule: A call of a function on a record of its package is the Go method's call, an mcall on the receiver (lower's funcDecl, methodReceiver).

mutants.name: lower-mcall-receiver-kept
mutants.rule: An mcall's operands are the call's after its receiver, which is its x.

mutants.name: lower-dep-alias-caller
mutants.rule: A call of another package's function names it by that package's alias (alias__name), not the caller's (NAME-LOCAL rule 2).

mutants.name: lower-stop-sourced-leaf-call
mutants.from: let first = try leafCallee(cst, i, name)
mutants.rule: An unboxed leaf never gets an inline site, even when it is called in a sourced root or is larger than the Go cost budget.

mutants.name: lower-control-tail-does-not-yield
mutants.from: row.first = try controlBlock(st, p, iff.Body, tail, loops)
mutants.to: row.first = try controlBlock(st, p, iff.Body, false, loops)
mutants.rule: A tail if yields from its then arm, not only from its else arm (ControlTail).

mutants.name: lower-control-return-operand-position
mutants.rule: An explicit return keeps the return token's position even when the value starts later (ControlReturn).

mutants.name: lower-control-shadow-reuses-name
mutants.rule: A shadow has a distinct Go local name even when its source name is already in use (ControlShadow).

mutants.name: lower-control-range-end-is-start
mutants.from:
ir.List(b, loop), ir.PosAt(b, pos(st, s.end)), 0})
		case CBreak:
mutants.to:
ir.List(b, loop), ir.PosAt(b, at), 0})
		case CBreak:
mutants.rule: A compact range's scope ends at its closing brace, not its opening for (ControlRange).

mutants.name: lower-control-continue-as-break
mutants.rule: Continue goes to the back edge, not out of the enclosing loop (ControlWhile).

mutants.name: lower-float-product-unrounded
mutants.rule: A float product that is no constant rounds under T(a * b), so Go cannot fuse it into a multiply-add (lower's rounded, FLOAT-STRICT).

mutants.name: lower-conv-type-from
mutants.from: aBuiltin{conv: true, t: to, arg: a}
mutants.to: aBuiltin{conv: true, t: from, arg: a}
mutants.rule: A conversion's conv row names the target type (lower's conversion: goType(c.Type)).

mutants.name: lower-conv-float-int-plain
mutants.rule: A float converted to an integer goes through the runtime's checked helper (lower's floatToInteger), never a plain conv.

mutants.name: lower-shape-slice-field-rejected
mutants.to: if store.KindOfType(st.s, f.T) == store.KSlice || !ordinaryFieldName(f.Name) || shapeWithin(st, f.T, path) == "" {
mutants.rule: A record with a slice field is a direct record receiver; the KeepNested witness must not disappear.

mutants.name: lower-shape-nested-record-field-rejected
mutants.to: if store.KindOfType(st.s, f.T) == store.KNamed || !ordinaryFieldName(f.Name) || shapeWithin(st, f.T, path) == "" {
mutants.rule: Shape admission recurses through a named field, as for Outer.Inner.

mutants.name: lower-shape-slice-field-key-suffixed
mutants.rule: The field operand keeps the checked Go member name regardless of its value's slice shape.

mutants.name: lower-shape-slice-parameter-rejected
mutants.to: if sig == "" && (shapeGo(*st, ops[i]) == "" || store.KindOfType(st.s, ops[i]) == store.KSlice) {
mutants.rule: A read-only slice parameter has a direct local operand; KeepSlice must not disappear.

mutants.name: lower-shape-slice-literal-spelling
mutants.from: return aggregate{typ: gt, record: -1, keys: []string{}, values: values}
mutants.to: return aggregate{typ: gt[2:len(gt)], record: -1, keys: []string{}, values: values}
mutants.rule: A slice literal's type operand includes the slice constructor, not just the element spelling.

mutants.name: ir-const-op-dropped
mutants.rule: A const row may set op ("quoted": a string constant that is not UTF-8, lower's irStringConst).

mutants.name: report-crlf-two-lines
mutants.rule: A CRLF ends one line, not two (internal/report sourcePositionIndex).

mutants.name: cachekey-framed-no-nul
mutants.rule: A framed key writes NUL after each part, as the test-result and warm keys do in Go.

mutants.name: source-fit-at-bound
mutants.rule: A source exactly as long as its bound fits (ReadRegularFile).

mutants.name: warm-key-drops-experiments
mutants.rule: The warm key covers the Go experiments, which choose a module's Go files (AnswerIsFresh).

mutants.name: snap-decode-skips-segment
mutants.rule: The snapshot agreement compares every std package of the export: a package the decode leaves out is a listed package that no longer agrees.

mutants.name: unused-draw-by-position
mutants.rule: An unused case is keyed by its own file: a pool that loses or gains other files leaves its perturbation unchanged.

mutants.name: source-edit-by-position
mutants.rule: A source's edit is keyed by its name: sources that lose or gain other members leave it unchanged.
